name: Bendamustine + Rituximab (BR) for marginal zone lymphoma
histology: marginal zone lymphoma (extranodal/MALT, nodal, or splenic)

biomarkers.note: Rituximab requires CD20 positivity (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, lines 253 to 254, 566). For Helicobacter pylori-positive early-stage gastric MALT (extranodal marginal zone) lymphoma, H. pylori eradication is first-line and precedes systemic chemoimmunotherapy; BR is a systemic option when systemic therapy is indicated.

treatmentSetting: systemic therapy for marginal zone lymphoma requiring treatment (advanced-stage or after failure of local/antibiotic therapy)
lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic (chemoimmunotherapy) option when systemic therapy is indicated

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: CD20-positive marginal zone lymphoma (extranodal/MALT, nodal, or splenic) requiring systemic therapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, Marginal Zone Lymphomas MZL-1 (line 93); EMZL-1 / NMZL-1 / SMZL-1 subtype sections (lines 652 to 661)

drugs.name: Bendamustine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY: bendamustine dose not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison/NCCN extracts.

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. The BR bendamustine dose (conventionally 90 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 2 of a 28-day cycle in indolent NHL) is not printed in the provided extracts. Verify dose before activation.

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.locator: Harrison line 385777 (rituximab 375 mg/m2 once a week for 4 weeks) and line 120283 (usual dose 375 mg/m2 on day -1 before chemotherapy); DeVita line 323457.

drugs.notes: Source: Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457. Rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of each cycle. Requires CD20 positivity; infusion-reaction premedication and HBV screening before anti-CD20 therapy.

supportiveCare: For H. pylori-positive gastric MALT lymphoma, H. pylori eradication is first-line and precedes chemoimmunotherapy.
HBV screening and reactivation prophylaxis before anti-CD20 (rituximab).
PJP and antiviral (VZV) prophylaxis consideration (bendamustine causes prolonged lymphopenia).
Antiemetics: bendamustine moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle
lymphocyte count / infection surveillance (prolonged lymphopenia with bendamustine)
renal and hepatic function before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

guideline.locator: Marginal Zone Lymphomas MZL-1 (line 93); EMZL/NMZL/SMZL subtype sections (lines 652 to 661); CD20 lines 253 to 254, 566

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for bendamustine + rituximab (BR) in marginal zone lymphoma (#78). The task disease list names marginal zone lymphoma but its regimen list did not specify a marginal-zone regimen; BR was drafted by analogy with the follicular and mantle cell BR protocols because it is an NCCN-listed indolent-NHL chemoimmunotherapy option and is groundable identically (no new dose invented). Rituximab 375 mg/m2 (day 1) is dose-grounded (Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457). Bendamustine dose is set to VERIFY: the BR bendamustine dose (conventionally 90 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 2, 28-day cycle) is not printed in the provided extracts. Regimen role and the CD20 requirement are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026 (MZL-1 line 93; subtype sections lines 652 to 661; CD20 lines 253 to 254, 566). For H. pylori-positive gastric MALT lymphoma, antibiotic eradication is first-line and precedes systemic therapy. Marginal zone lymphoma is generally not curable with this regimen, so intent is palliative (disease control). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
